# the contributor analytic audit: exact contacts, physical mixtures, ordinary energy


None proves a positive OC deformation game value or a center selection.

## Forced-contact supporting slopes

Read every section of
`candidate 4bf40258fc44a4e6`.
The fixed-matrix projection argument handles deficient rank and failure
of strict feasibility: minimal conic KKT representations use independent
active rows, so a finite collection of continuous affine formulas gives
bounded subsequential limits with the correct unique KKT solution.
Projection nonexpansiveness bounds growth with the target q. Positive
summable weights with finite first target moment therefore give uniform
convergence to one bounded continuous feasible slope. Nonnegative slacks
and density of the targets prove its contacts are exactly the forced ones
for every normal, rather than only almost everywhere.

The linear-program dual signs check: maximizing v_z A subject to VA>=c
has dual V^T t=-v_z, t>=0, objective -c.t. Forced value c_z gives
c.t=-c_z. Adding the z unit weight and normalizing is precisely a tight
anchored representation. Its decomposition into extreme representations
retains an extreme tight relation with positive z weight. The resulting
finite union of closed normal sets is measurable. Directional equality
is not promoted to whole-body equality. The application uses the already
proved actual global cuts and retains their maximum of active sources
and their correct inward cap selectors. Smaller unsigned losses do not
imply larger signed payment; the source explicitly preserves this limit.

## One-source field mixtures

Read every section of
`candidate 4c4db2dc9830c76a`.
The averaged field is an actual convex function before any body is cut.
Uniform inner homothets prove positivity and preserve the entire base.
Its fixed contact set makes first speed linear. The radial active-normal
proof covers zero speeds and disappearing strict slack, nonsmooth fibers,
and d=1. Fixed supporting caps use actual inward-loss status. I corrected
one sentence to say that the CUTTING HYPERPLANE, rather than the proper
halfspace itself, has surface-null boundary intersection.

Weak compactness of probability measures on the nonempty compact metric
parameter space, joint continuity of the fields, and finite domain nets
give compactness in uniform field norm. The sequential radial argument
then proves uniform o(epsilon) for a finite cap menu. There is no varying
contact indicator. Response coordinates consequently form the exact
compact convex hull of pure response vectors. Separation by a positive
orthant proves the stated attained finite-menu minimax, with correct
Caratheodory support counts. Strictly positive value remains an additional
hypothesis; neither compactness nor response convexity establishes it.
Several sources and varying support slopes are expressly excluded from
the linear-response theorem.

## Sharp ordinary retained-cap comparison

Read every section of
`candidate 49e262af8d182671`.
The hinge dual is coercive by the source inner ball, is continuously
differentiable, and its zero derivative gives a positive centroidal cap.
Pointwise hinge equality proves attainment and uniqueness of the physical
retained density. The energy coercivity cone and positive Hessian certify
the unique projective parameter. The tangent power inequality proves
T<=E with equality exactly at the ordinary centroid.

For the upper comparison, cap height has mean one and homothetic survival
gives maximal height at most d+1. The matched-moment comparison cone has
exactly the stated mass and first moment. Concavity of the section root
gives the -,+,- sign pattern; the two matched moments exclude a positive
interval touching either endpoint. The secant-line proof then gives the
convex-order integral inequality. Concavity extends the upper cone bound
to all negative actual heights, while the cone's extra infinite negative
tail gives strictness. Its beta integral equals T/(d+1)^d before the
outer (d+1)^(d+1) factor. The simplex cap has an actual hinge certificate;
E/T=(d+1)(1-d epsilon) proves the sharp limiting loss. Intervals are
handled separately. the contributor reran the supplementary verifier:12,004 exact
checks passed across180 actual concave profiles. They supplement this
analytic audit.

## Facet energy and escort limit

Read every section, including the appended escort recursion, of
`candidate 1389446c1fac70ac`.
the contributor independently derived the main proof before reading this source.
Normal dilation fixes the marked point and gives a uniform inner ball.
Convex interpolation with the facet proves the lower local section
inclusion; compactness proves the upper one. The fixed projection bounds
all tangential coordinates. Minimizer parameters are bounded by the
inner ball; the proved optimal denominator floor passes to the limiting
prism. A zero limiting normal coefficient would give an infinite prism
integral by Fatou and contradict the uniform test upper bound. The prism
integral separates exactly, with unique normal parameter1/(d+1) and
tangential parameter d a_F/(d+1).

For the upper limit that same fixed parameter is admissible on every
small-delta body: compact-height section convergence gives a positive
floor and the positive normal coefficient handles the tail uniformly.
An integrable inverse-power tail gives dominated convergence. Thus all
actual minimizers converge, justifying the stated pointwise derivative
limits by the envelope identity, without an infimum/limit interchange.
The escort integrands have exponent d+2, so both mass and first normal
moment have integrable uniform tails. Their exact marginal exponent is
d+1, precisely the lower-dimensional escort, and all constants cancel.
d=1 uses the single facet point with H_0 and no tangential parameter.
the contributor reran271 exact checks. No lower-dimensional general exposed face,
uniform edge limit, depth center, or OC inference is included.
